title: Temporary Credit Owed on a Registered Billing Dispute, Personal Credit Cards
content:
A billing dispute that has been registered on a personal credit card account and still stands in submitted status owes the cardholder a temporary credit, and this rule fixes the size of it. It governs disputes on cards under Personal Credit Cards.

**When it is owed.** The credit is owed as soon as the dispute stands in submitted status and is posted at the next reconciliation of the account, whether or not the cardholder raises it again. A card account carrying no dispute in submitted status is out of scope of this rule and nothing is credited.

**How the credit is posted.** The temporary credit is posted by `post_card_dispute_credit_83d80881`, a tool the agent unlocks and then calls. One call books a single temporary credit entry on the card's ledger, marked as a provisional dispute credit, tied both to the dispute being worked and to the charge under dispute, and dated the day of the call in that day's statement cycle. The same call lowers the balance owed on the card account by the credited amount, and the cardholder sees the credit on the card's activity list and a smaller balance owed.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
|---|---|---|
| `card_account_id` | The reference number of the credit card account whose ledger receives the temporary credit and whose balance owed falls; read from the card account lookup for this cardholder before the call. | An identifier |
| `customer_id` | The reference number identifying the cardholder profile the credited card account belongs to; read from the customer profile lookup before the call. | An identifier |
| `card_dispute_id` | The reference number of the billing dispute this temporary credit belongs to; read from the card dispute lookup before the call. | An identifier |
| `source_item_id` | The reference number of the single card ledger entry that is the charge under dispute; read from the card dispute record or the card activity lookup before the call. | An identifier |
| `provisional_credit_amount` | The money credited to the cardholder while the dispute is worked, expressed exactly as the ledger records a money amount. | US dollars to 2 decimal places, or an empty string; always a positive number carried to 2 decimal places and rounded half-up. The figure itself is passed, never a proportion or a share. |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence in plain text. It names the new ledger entry's own reference number, repeats the credited amount in US dollars to two decimals, names the dispute reference number and the card account reference number, and states the balance owed after the credit, also in US dollars to two decimals. A sentence of that shape means the entry was booked and the balance was lowered; anything beginning with Error means nothing was written.
